function atlasMetalsMathFinite(value) {
  const number = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(number) ? number : null;
}

function atlasMetalsMathSampleStd(values) {
  const rows = (Array.isArray(values) ? values : [])
    .map(atlasMetalsMathFinite)
    .filter(Number.isFinite);
  if (rows.length < 2) return null;
  const mean = rows.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / rows.length;
  const variance = rows.reduce(
    (sum, value) => sum + (value - mean) ** 2,
    0
  ) / (rows.length - 1);
  return Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, variance));
}

function atlasMetalsMathDrawdown(points) {
  if (!Array.isArray(points) || points.length < 2) return null;
  let peak = points[0];
  let peakIndex = 0;
  let maxPct = 0;
  let start = points[0];
  let trough = points[0];
  points.forEach((point, index) => {
    if (point.y > peak.y) {
      peak = point;
      peakIndex = index;
    }
    const pct = peak.y > 0 ? ((peak.y - point.y) / peak.y) * 100 : 0;
    if (pct > maxPct) {
      maxPct = pct;
      start = points[peakIndex];
      trough = point;
    }
  });
  return { pct: maxPct, start, trough };
}

function atlasMetalsMathCoreMetrics() {
  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  const asset = atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal();
  const periodDays = Number(metals.period || 7);
  const periodLabel = atlasChartPeriodLabel(periodDays);
  const rows = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPeriodRows(periodDays);
  const points = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(asset.id, periodDays);
  const returns = [];
  for (let index = 1; index < points.length; index += 1) {
    const previous = Number(points[index - 1].y);
    const current = Number(points[index].y);
    if (previous > 0 && current > 0) returns.push(Math.log(current / previous));
  }
  const volatilitySessionPct = returns.length >= 2
    ? atlasMetalsMathSampleStd(returns) * 100
    : null;
  const drawdown = atlasMetalsMathDrawdown(points);
  const values = points.map(point => Number(point.y)).filter(Number.isFinite);
  const low = values.length ? Math.min(...values) : null;
  const high = values.length ? Math.max(...values) : null;
  const amplitudePct = Number.isFinite(low) && low > 0 && Number.isFinite(high)
    ? ((high - low) / low) * 100
    : null;
  const completenessPct = rows.length
    ? Math.min(100, (points.length / rows.length) * 100)
    : null;
  const reading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(asset.id, periodDays);
  const quote = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationQuote(asset.id);
  const first = points[0] || null;
  const last = points[points.length - 1] || null;
  const latestStepPct = points.length >= 2
    ? ((points[points.length - 1].y / points[points.length - 2].y) - 1) * 100
    : null;
  return {
    asset,
    periodDays,
    periodLabel,
    rows,
    points,
    returns,
    reading,
    quote,
    first,
    last,
    latestStepPct,
    volatilitySessionPct,
    drawdown,
    low,
    high,
    amplitudePct,
    completenessPct,
    ready: reading?.available === true && points.length >= 2
  };
}

function atlasMetalsMathFormatPct(value, digits = 2) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(Number(value))) return "Indisponible";
  const number = Number(value);
  const sign = number > 0 ? "+" : "";
  return `${sign}${new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
    minimumFractionDigits: digits,
    maximumFractionDigits: digits
  }).format(number)} %`;
}

function atlasMetalsMathDate(value) {
  const timestamp = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(timestamp)
    ? new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString("fr-FR")
    : "—";
}

function atlasMetalsMathRestoreCryptoLabels() {
  const shell = document.getElementById("math");
  if (!shell) return false;
  shell.dataset.mathDomain = "crypto";
  shell.classList.remove("atlas-math-metals");
  const eyebrow = shell.querySelector(".atlas-math-dock-head .eyebrow");
  const title = shell.querySelector(".atlas-math-dock-head h2");
  const muted = shell.querySelector(".muted-line");
  const detailsTitle = shell.querySelector(".atlas-score-components h3");
  if (eyebrow) eyebrow.textContent = "ATLAS MATH CORE V3";
  if (title) title.textContent = "Risque historique et qualité de série";
  if (muted) muted.textContent = "Lecture humaine d’abord · mesures factuelles et limites visibles.";
  if (detailsTitle) detailsTitle.textContent = "Composantes de l’indice";
  return true;
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationIntradaySeries(assetId) {
  return atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationArray(atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.intradayHistory?.series)
    .find(record => String(record?.asset_id || "") === String(assetId || "")) || null;
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationIntradayPoints(assetId) {
  const series = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationIntradaySeries(assetId);
  const points = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationArray(series?.points)
    .map(point => ({
      x: Date.parse(String(point?.time || "")),
      y: Number(point?.close),
      currency: String(series?.currency || "USD").toUpperCase(),
      unit: String(series?.unit || ""),
      source: "yahoo_finance_intraday"
    }))
    .filter(point => Number.isFinite(point.x) && Number.isFinite(point.y) && point.y > 0)
    .sort((left, right) => left.x - right.x);
  if (!points.length) return [];
  const newest = points[points.length - 1].x;
  const cutoff = newest - 24 * 3600000;
  const unique = new Map();
  points.filter(point => point.x >= cutoff).forEach(point => unique.set(String(point.x), point));
  return [...unique.values()].sort((left, right) => left.x - right.x);
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPeriodRows(periodDays) {
  const days = Number(periodDays || 365);
  if (days === 1) {
    return atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationIntradayPoints(atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal().id)
      .map(point => ({ time: point.x, point }));
  }
  const rows = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHistoryRows();
  if (!rows.length) return [];
  const newestTime = rows[rows.length - 1].time;
  const cutoff = newestTime - Math.max(1, days) * 86400000;
  const inside = rows.filter(row => row.time >= cutoff);
  const anchor = [...rows].reverse().find(row => row.time < cutoff) || null;
  const selected = anchor ? [anchor, ...inside] : inside;
  const unique = new Map();
  selected.forEach(row => unique.set(String(row.time), row));
  return [...unique.values()].sort((left, right) => left.time - right.time);
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(assetId, periodDays = null) {
  if (Number(periodDays) === 1) {
    return atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationIntradayPoints(assetId);
  }
  const rows = periodDays === null
    ? atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHistoryRows()
    : atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPeriodRows(periodDays);
  return rows.map(row => {
    const quote = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationArray(row.snapshot?.quotes)
      .find(item => item?.asset_id === assetId
        && String(item?.instrument_type || "") === "future_continuous");
    const price = Number(quote?.price);
    if (!Number.isFinite(price) || price <= 0) return null;
    return {
      x: row.time,
      y: price,
      currency: String(quote?.currency || "USD").toUpperCase(),
      unit: String(quote?.unit || ""),
      source: "yahoo_finance"
    };
  }).filter(Boolean);
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationChartSeries() {
  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  const selected = new Set(metals.selectionIds);
  const activeId = atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal().id;
  const periodDays = Number(metals.period || 365);
  const series = [];

  for (const asset of ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS) {
    if (!selected.has(asset.id)) continue;
    // Les unités et ordres de grandeur diffèrent fortement.
    // En mode Prix, une seule échelle réelle est affichée : l'actif actif.
    // La comparaison multi-actifs est réservée au mode Base 100.
    if (metals.view !== "base100" && asset.id !== activeId) continue;
    const points = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(asset.id, periodDays);
    if (!points.length) continue;
    if (metals.view === "base100") {
      const base = points[0].y;
      points.forEach(point => { point.y = (point.y / base) * 100; });
    }
    series.push({
      id: asset.id,
      symbol: asset.symbol,
      color: ATLAS_METALS_CHART_COLORS[asset.id],
      points
    });
  }
  return series;
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(assetId, periodDays) {
  const days = Number(periodDays);
  const intraday = days === 1;
  const points = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(assetId, days);
  const unitLabel = intraday ? "points Futures intraday" : "séances Futures";
  const spanHours = points.length >= 2
    ? Math.max(0, (points[points.length - 1].x - points[0].x) / 3600000)
    : 0;

  if (points.length < 2) {
    const count = points.length;
    return Object.freeze({
      available: false,
      partial: intraday && count > 0,
      state: "insufficient",
      text: intraday ? "Intraday Futures en attente" : "Historique insuffisant",
      detail: intraday
        ? `${count} point${count > 1 ? "s" : ""} Futures intraday réel${count > 1 ? "s" : ""} · première collecte GitHub Actions requise`
        : `${count} séance${count > 1 ? "s" : ""} Futures réelle${count > 1 ? "s" : ""}`,
      points: count,
      spanHours
    });
  }

  const first = points[0];
  const last = points[points.length - 1];
  const delta = last.y - first.y;
  const percent = first.y !== 0 ? (delta / first.y) * 100 : null;
  if (!Number.isFinite(percent)) {
    return Object.freeze({
      available: false,
      state: "incoherent",
      text: "Variation non calculable",
      detail: `${points.length} ${unitLabel}`,
      points: points.length,
      spanHours
    });
  }

  const sign = percent > 0 ? "+" : "";
  const formatted = new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2
  }).format(percent);
  const dateOptions = intraday
    ? { day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }
    : undefined;
  return Object.freeze({
    available: true,
    state: percent > 0 ? "up" : percent < 0 ? "down" : "stable",
    text: `${sign}${formatted} % · ${points.length} ${unitLabel}`,
    detail: `${new Date(first.x).toLocaleString("fr-FR", dateOptions)} → ${new Date(last.x).toLocaleString("fr-FR", dateOptions)}`,
    percent,
    delta,
    points: points.length,
    first,
    last,
    spanHours,
    source: intraday ? "yahoo_finance_futures_intraday" : "yahoo_finance_futures_daily"
  });
}

    periodDays ?? atl

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationComparison(periodDays = null) {
  const days = Number(
    periodDays ?? atlasParallelMarketMetalsState().period ?? 7
  );
  const rows = ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.map(asset => {
    const reading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(asset.id, days);
    return Object.freeze({
      asset,
      reading,
      available: reading?.available === true,
      percent: reading?.available === true
        ? Number(reading.percent)
        : null
    });
  });
  const available = rows
    .filter(row => row.available && Number.isFinite(row.percent))
    .sort((left, right) => right.percent - left.percent);
  const leader = available[0] || null;
  const laggard = available[available.length - 1] || null;
  const spread = leader && laggard
    ? leader.percent - laggard.percent
    : null;
  return Object.freeze({
    days,
    rows: Object.freeze(rows),
    available: Object.freeze(available),
    count: available.length,
    complete: available.length === ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.length,
    leader,
    laggard,
    spread
  });
}

    state: percent > 0 ? "up" : percent < 0 ? "down" : "stable",
    text: `${sign}${formatted} % · ${points.length} ${unitLabel}`,
    detail: `${new Date(first.x).toLocaleString("fr-FR", dateOptions)} → ${new Date(last.x).toLocaleString("fr-FR", dateOptions)}`,
    percent,
    delta,
    points: points.length,
    first,
    last,
    spanHours,
    source: intraday ? "yahoo_finance_futures_intraday" : "yahoo_finance_futures_daily"
  });
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationComparison(periodDays = null) {
  const days = Number(
    periodDays ?? atlasParallelMarketMetalsState().period ?? 7
  );
  const rows = ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.map(asset => {
    const reading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(asset.id, days);
    return Object.freeze({
      asset,
      reading,
      available: reading?.available === true,
      percent: reading?.available === true
        ? Number(reading.percent)
        : null
    });
  });
  const available = rows
    .filter(row => row.available && Number.isFinite(row.percent))
    .sort((left, right) => right.percent - left.percent);
  const leader = available[0] || null;
  const laggard = available[available.length - 1] || null;
  const spread = leader && laggard
    ? leader.percent - laggard.percent
    : null;
  return Object.freeze({
    days,
    rows: Object.freeze(rows),
    available: Object.freeze(available),
    count: available.length,
    complete: available.length === ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.length,
    leader,
    laggard,
    spread
  });
}

    card.classList.toggle("is-down", reading.state === "down");

--- atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints #5 @2028045 ---
arestPoint(points, targetX) {
  const rows = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationArray(points);
  if (!rows.length || !Number.isFinite(Number(targetX))) return null;
  let low = 0;
  let high = rows.length - 1;
  while (low < high) {
    const middle = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
    if (Number(rows[middle]?.x) < targetX) low = middle + 1;
    else high = middle;
  }
  const right = rows[low] || null;
  const left = rows[Math.max(0, low - 1)] || null;
  if (!left) return right;
  if (!right) return left;
  return Math.abs(Number(left.x) - targetX) <= Math.abs(Number(right.x) - targetX)
    ? left
    : right;
}

function atlasMetalsCursorMedianInterval(points) {
  const rows = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationArray(points)
    .map(point => Number(point?.x))
    .filter(Number.isFinite)
    .sort((left, right) => left - right);
  if (rows.length < 2) return Infinity;
  const intervals = [];
  for (let index = 1; index < rows.length; index += 1) {
    const delta = rows[index] - rows[index - 1];
    if (delta > 0) intervals.push(delta);
  }
  if (!intervals.length) return Infinity;
  intervals.sort((left, right) => left - right);
  return intervals[Math.floor(intervals.length / 2)];
}

function atlasMetalsCursorHistoricalPriceText(value, assetId) {
  const amount = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount)) return "—";
  const digits = assetId === "copper"
    ? 4
    : Math.abs(amount) >= 1000 ? 1 : Math.abs(amount) >= 100 ? 2 : 3;
  return `${new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
    minimumFractionDigits: digits,
    maximumFractionDigits: digits
  }).format(amount)} USD`;
}

function atlasMetalsCursorChangeText(value) {
  const change = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(change)) return "—";
  const normalized = Math.abs(change) < 0.005 ? 0 : change;
  return `${normalized > 0 ? "+" : ""}${new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2
  }).format(normalized)} %`;
}

function atlasMetalsCursorInspectorRows(targetX) {
  const geometry = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.geometry;
  if (!geometry) return [];
  const periodDays = Number(geometry.periodDays || 7);
  return geometry.series.map(displaySeries => {
    const rawPoints = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(displaySeries.id, periodDays);
    const rawPoint = atlasMetalsCursorNearestPoint(rawPoints, targetX);
    const displayPoint = atlasMetalsCursorNearestPoint(displaySeries.points, targetX);
    const nativeInterval = atlasMetalsCursorMedianInterval(rawPoints);
    const distance = rawPoint ? Math.abs(Number(rawPoint.x) - Number(targetX)) : Infinity;
    if (!rawPoint || !displayPoint || (Number.isFinite(nativeInterval) && distance > nativeInterval * 4)) return null;
    const first = rawPoints[0] || null;
    const price = Number(rawPoint?.y);
    const change = first && Number(first.y) !== 0 && Number.isFinite(price)
      ? ((price / Number(first.y)) - 1) * 100
      : null;
    const asset = ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.find(item => item.id === displaySeries.id) || {
      id: displaySeries.id,
      symbol: displaySeries.symbol || displaySeries.id.toUpperCase(),
      name: displaySeries.symbol || displaySeries.id
    };
    return {
      asset,
      color: displaySeries.color || ATLAS_METALS_CHART_COLORS[displaySeries.id] || "#9fb3c2",
      rawPoint,
      displayPoint,
      price,
      change,
      time: Number(rawPoint?.x ?? displayPoint?.x)
    };
  }).filter(row => row && row.rawPoint && row.displayPoint && Number.isFinite(row.time));
}

function atlasMetalsCursorInspectorTimestamp(rows, targetX) {
  const activeId = atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal()?.id;
  const preferred = rows.find(row => row.asset.id === activeId) || rows[0] || null;
  return Number(preferred?.time || targetX);
}

function atlasMetalsCursorInspectorPosition(canvas, pointerX, pointerY) {
  const panel = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorPanel();
  const stage = canvas?.parentElement;
  if (!panel || !stage) return;
  const width = panel.offsetWidth || 350;
  const height = panel.offsetHeight || 260;
  const stageWidth = stage.clientWidth || canvas.clientWidth || 760;
  const stageHeight = stage.clientHeight || canvas.clientHeight || 230;
  const gap = 18;
  const edge = 10;
  const roomRight = stageWidth - pointerX - gap - edge;
  const roomLeft = pointerX - gap - edge;
  const previous = panel.dataset.dock === "left" || panel.dataset.dock === "right"
    ? panel.dataset.dock
    : "";
  const tolerance = 34;
  let dock = previous || (roomRight >= width || roomRight >= roomLeft ? "right" : "left");
  if (dock === "right" && roomRight < width && roomLeft > roomRight + tolerance) dock = "left";
  if (dock === "left" && roomLeft < width && roomRight > roomLeft + tolerance) dock = "right";
  let left = dock === "left" ? pointerX - width - gap : pointerX + gap;
  let top = pointerY - height * .5;
  left = clamp(edge, Math.max(edge, stageWidth - width - edge), left);
  top = clamp(edge, Math.max(edge, stageHeight - height - edge), top);
  panel.dataset.dock = dock;
  panel.style.left = `${Math.round(left)}px`;
  panel.style.top = `${Math.round(top)}px`;
}

  const panel = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorPanel();
  const geometry = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.geometry;
  if (!panel || !geometry || !rows.length) {
    atlasMetalsCursorInspectorHide();
    return false;
  }
  const stamp = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorTimestamp(rows, targetX);
  const intraday = Number(geometry.periodDays) === 1;
  const time = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsChartMarketTime");
  const origin = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsChartMarketOrigin");
  const period = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsChartMarketPeriod");
  const source = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsChartMarketSource");
  if (time) {
    const date = new Date(stamp);
    time.textContent = date.toLocaleString("fr-FR", intraday
      ? { day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", year: "numeric", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }
      : { day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", year: "numeric" });
    time.dateTime = date.toISOString();
  }
  if (origin) origin.textContent = intraday
    ? "Yahoo Finance Futures · point intraday 5 min"
    : "Yahoo Finance Futures · séance quotidienne";
  if (period) period.textContent = `PÉRIODE ACTIVE · ${atlasMetalsChartMarketPeriodLabel(geometry.periodDays)}`;

function atlasMetalsMathFinite(value) {
  const number = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(number) ? number : null;
}

function atlasMetalsMathSampleStd(values) {
  const rows = (Array.isArray(values) ? values : [])
    .map(atlasMetalsMathFinite)
    .filter(Number.isFinite);
  if (rows.length < 2) return null;
  const mean = rows.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / rows.length;
  const variance = rows.reduce(
    (sum, value) => sum + (value - mean) ** 2,
    0
  ) / (rows.length - 1);
  return Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, variance));
}

function atlasMetalsMathDrawdown(points) {
  if (!Array.isArray(points) || points.length < 2) return null;
  let peak = points[0];
  let peakIndex = 0;
  let maxPct = 0;
  let start = points[0];
  let trough = points[0];
  points.forEach((point, index) => {
    if (point.y > peak.y) {
      peak = point;
      peakIndex = index;
    }
    const pct = peak.y > 0 ? ((peak.y - point.y) / peak.y) * 100 : 0;
    if (pct > maxPct) {
      maxPct = pct;
      start = points[peakIndex];
      trough = point;
    }
  });
  return { pct: maxPct, start, trough };
}

function atlasMetalsMathCoreMetrics() {
  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  const asset = atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal();
  const periodDays = Number(metals.period || 7);
  const periodLabel = atlasChartPeriodLabel(periodDays);
  const rows = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPeriodRows(periodDays);
  const points = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(asset.id, periodDays);
  const returns = [];
  for (let index = 1; index < points.length; index += 1) {
    const previous = Number(points[index - 1].y);
    const current = Number(points[index].y);
    if (previous > 0 && current > 0) returns.push(Math.log(current / previous));
  }
  const volatilitySessionPct = returns.length >= 2
    ? atlasMetalsMathSampleStd(returns) * 100
    : null;
  const drawdown = atlasMetalsMathDrawdown(points);
  const values = points.map(point => Number(point.y)).filter(Number.isFinite);
  const low = values.length ? Math.min(...values) : null;
  const high = values.length ? Math.max(...values) : null;
  const amplitudePct = Number.isFinite(low) && low > 0 && Number.isFinite(high)
    ? ((high - low) / low) * 100
    : null;
  const completenessPct = rows.length
    ? Math.min(100, (points.length / rows.length) * 100)
    : null;
  const reading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(asset.id, periodDays);
  const quote = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationQuote(asset.id);
  const first = points[0] || null;
  const last = points[points.length - 1] || null;
  const latestStepPct = points.length >= 2
    ? ((points[points.length - 1].y / points[points.length - 2].y) - 1) * 100
    : null;
  return {
    asset,
    periodDays,
    periodLabel,
    rows,
    points,
    returns,
    reading,
    quote,
    first,
    last,
    latestStepPct,
    volatilitySessionPct,
    drawdown,
    low,
    high,
    amplitudePct,
    completenessPct,
    ready: reading?.available === true && points.length >= 2
  };
}

function atlasMetalsMathFormatPct(value, digits = 2) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(Number(value))) return "Indisponible";
  const number = Number(value);
  const sign = number > 0 ? "+" : "";
  return `${sign}${new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
    minimumFractionDigits: digits,
    maximumFractionDigits: digits
  }).format(number)} %`;
}

function atlasMetalsMathDate(value) {
  const timestamp = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(timestamp)
    ? new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString("fr-FR")
    : "—";
}

  return true;

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationSpotRows() {
  const snapshots = [
    ...atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationArray(atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.spotHistory)
  ];
  const current = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.snapshot;
  if (current && String(current?.provider_id || "") === "gold_api") snapshots.push(current);
  const unique = new Map();
  snapshots.forEach(snapshot => {
    const time = Date.parse(String(snapshot?.saved_at || snapshot?.quotes?.[0]?.received_at || ""));
    if (!Number.isFinite(time) || Number(snapshot?.assets_count || 0) !== 5) return;
    unique.set(String(time), { snapshot, time });
  });
  return [...unique.values()].sort((left, right) => left.time - right.time);
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationIntradaySeries(assetId) {
  return atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationArray(atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.intradayHistory?.series)
    .find(record => String(record?.asset_id || "") === String(assetId || "")) || null;
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationIntradayPoints(assetId) {
  const series = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationIntradaySeries(assetId);
  const points = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationArray(series?.points)
    .map(point => ({
      x: Date.parse(String(point?.time || "")),
      y: Number(point?.close),
      currency: String(series?.currency || "USD").toUpperCase(),
      unit: String(series?.unit || ""),
      source: "yahoo_finance_intraday"
    }))
    .filter(point => Number.isFinite(point.x) && Number.isFinite(point.y) && point.y > 0)
    .sort((left, right) => left.x - right.x);
  if (!points.length) return [];
  const newest = points[points.length - 1].x;
  const cutoff = newest - 24 * 3600000;
  const unique = new Map();
  points.filter(point => point.x >= cutoff).forEach(point => unique.set(String(point.x), point));
  return [...unique.values()].sort((left, right) => left.x - right.x);
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPeriodRows(periodDays) {
  const days = Number(periodDays || 365);
  if (days === 1) {
    return atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationIntradayPoints(atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal().id)
      .map(point => ({ time: point.x, point }));
  }
  const rows = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHistoryRows();
  if (!rows.length) return [];
  const newestTime = rows[rows.length - 1].time;
  const cutoff = newestTime - Math.max(1, days) * 86400000;
  const inside = rows.filter(row => row.time >= cutoff);
  const anchor = [...rows].reverse().find(row => row.time < cutoff) || null;
  const selected = anchor ? [anchor, ...inside] : inside;
  const unique = new Map();
  selected.forEach(row => unique.set(String(row.time), row));
  return [...unique.values()].sort((left, right) => left.time - right.time);
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(assetId, periodDays = null) {
  if (Number(periodDays) === 1) {
    return atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationIntradayPoints(assetId);
  }
  const rows = periodDays === null
    ? atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHistoryRows()
    : atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPeriodRows(periodDays);
  return rows.map(row => {
    const quote = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationArray(row.snapshot?.quotes)
      .find(item => item?.asset_id === assetId
        && String(item?.instrument_type || "") === "future_continuous");
    const price = Number(quote?.price);
    if (!Number.isFinite(price) || price <= 0) return null;
    return {
      x: row.time,
      y: price,
      currency: String(quote?.currency || "USD").toUpperCase(),
      unit: String(quote?.unit || ""),
      source: "yahoo_finance"
    };
  }).filter(Boolean);
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationChartSeries() {
  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  const selected = new Set(metals.selectionIds);
  const activeId = atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal().id;
  const periodDays = Number(metals.period || 365);
  const series = [];

  for (const asset of ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS) {
    if (!selected.has(asset.id)) continue;
    // Les unités et ordres de grandeur diffèrent fortement.
    // En mode Prix, une seule échelle réelle est affichée : l'actif actif.
    // La comparaison multi-actifs est réservée au mode Base 100.
    if (metals.view !== "base100" && asset.id !== activeId) continue;
    const points = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(asset.id, periodDays);
    if (!points.length) continue;
    if (metals.view === "base100") {
      const base = points[0].y;
      points.forEach(point => { point.y = (point.y / base) * 100; });
    }
    series.push({
      id: asset.id,
      symbol: asset.symbol,
      color: ATLAS_METALS_CHART_COLORS[asset.id],
      points
    });
  }
  return series;
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(assetId, periodDays) {

    ? Math.max(0, (points[points.length - 1].x - points[0].x) / 3600000)
    : 0;

    const count = points.length;

      state: "insufficient",

        : `${count} séance${count > 1 ? "s" : ""} Futures réelle${count > 1 ? "s" : ""}`,
      points: count,
      spanHours
    });
  }

  const first = points[0];
  const last = points[points.length - 1];
  const delta = last.y - first.y;
  const percent = first.y !== 0 ? (delta / first.y) * 100 : null;
  if (!Number.isFinite(percent)) {
    return Object.freeze({
      available: false,
      state: "incoherent",
      text: "Variation non calculable",
      detail: `${points.length} ${unitLabel}`,
      points: points.length,
      spanHours
    });
  }

  const sign = percent > 0 ? "+" : "";
  const formatted = new Intl.NumberFormat("f

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPeriodRows(periodDays) {
  const days = Number(periodDays || 365);
  if (days === 1) {
    return atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationIntradayPoints(atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal().id)
      .map(point => ({ time: point.x, point }));
  }
  const rows = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHistoryRows();
  if (!rows.length) return [];
  const newestTime = rows[rows.length - 1].time;
  const cutoff = newestTime - Math.max(1, days) * 86400000;
  const inside = rows.filter(row => row.time >= cutoff);
  const anchor = [...rows].reverse().find(row => row.time < cutoff) || null;
  const selected = anchor ? [anchor, ...inside] : inside;
  const unique = new Map();
  selected.forEach(row => unique.set(String(row.time), row));
  return [...unique.values()].sort((left, right) => left.time - right.time);
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(assetId, periodDays = null) {
  if (Number(periodDays) === 1) {
    return atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationIntradayPoints(assetId);
  }
  const rows = periodDays === null
    ? atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHistoryRows()
    : atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPeriodRows(periodDays);
  return rows.map(row => {
    const quote = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationArray(row.snapshot?.quotes)
      .find(item => item?.asset_id === assetId
        && String(item?.instrument_type || "") === "future_continuous");
    const price = Number(quote?.price);
    if (!Number.isFinite(price) || price <= 0) return null;
    return {
      x: row.time,
      y: price,
      currency: String(quote?.currency || "USD").toUpperCase(),
      unit: String(quote?.unit || ""),
      source: "yahoo_finance"
    };
  }).filter(Boolean);
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationChartSeries() {
  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  const selected = new Set(metals.selectionIds);
  const activeId = atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal().id;
  const periodDays = Number(metals.period || 365);
  const series = [];

  for (const asset of ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS) {
    if (!selected.has(asset.id)) continue;
    // Les unités et ordres de grandeur diffèrent fortement.
    // En mode Prix, une seule échelle réelle est affichée : l'actif actif.
    // La comparaison multi-actifs est réservée au mode Base 100.
    if (metals.view !== "base100" && asset.id !== activeId) continue;
    const points = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(asset.id, periodDays);
    if (!points.length) continue;
    if (metals.view === "base100") {
      const base = points[0].y;
      points.forEach(point => { point.y = (point.y / base) * 100; });
    }
    series.push({
      id: asset.id,
      symbol: asset.symbol,
      color: ATLAS_METALS_CHART_COLORS[asset.id],
      points
    });
  }
  return series;
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(assetId, periodDays) {
  const days = Number(periodDays);
  const intraday = days === 1;
  const points = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(assetId, days);
  const unitLabel = intraday ? "points Futures intraday" : "séances Futures";
  const spanHours = points.length >= 2
    ? Math.max(0, (points[points.length - 1].x - points[0].x) / 3600000)
    : 0;

  if (points.length < 2) {
    const count = points.length;
    return Object.freeze({
      available: false,
      partial: intraday && count > 0,
      state: "insufficient",
      text: intraday ? "Intraday Futures en attente" : "Historique insuffisant",
      detail: intraday
        ? `${count} point${count > 1 ? "s" : ""} Futures intraday réel${count > 1 ? "s" : ""} · première collecte GitHub Actions requise`
        : `${count} séance${count > 1 ? "s" : ""} Futures réelle${count > 1 ? "s" : ""}`,
      points: count,
      spanHours
    });
  }

  const first = points[0];
  const last = points[points.length - 1];
  const delta = last.y - first.y;
  const percent = first.y !== 0 ? (delta / first.y) * 100 : null;
  if (!Number.isFinite(percent)) {
    return Object.freeze({
      available: false,
      state: "incoherent",
      text: "Variation non calculable",
      detail: `${points.length} ${unitLabel}`,
      points: points.length,
      spanHours
    });
  }

  const sign = percent > 0 ? "+" : "";
  const formatted = new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2
  }).format(percent);
  const dateOptions = intraday
    ? { day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }
    : undefined;
  return Object.freeze({
    available: true,
    state: percent > 0 ? "up" : percent < 0 ? "down" : "stable",
    text: `${sign}${formatted} % · ${points.length} ${unitLabel}`,
    detail: `${new Date(first.x).toLocaleString("fr-FR", dateOptions)} → ${new Date(last.x).toLocaleString("fr-FR", dateOptions)}`,
    percent,
    delta,
    points: points.length,
    first,
    last,
    spanHours,
    source: intraday ? "yahoo_finance_futures_intraday" : "yahoo_finance_futures_daily"
  });
}

    periodDays ?? atlasParallelMarketMetalsState().period ?? 7
  );
  const rows = ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.map(asset => {
    const reading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(asset.id, days);
    return Object.freeze({
      asset,
      reading,
      available: reading?

### atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading occurrences=9 positions=[1954299, 2009683, 2012093, 2013438, 2018873, 2020680, 2022840, 2057141, 2058538]

--- atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading #1 @1954299 ---
 const rows = (Array.isArray(values) ? values : [])
    .map(atlasMetalsMathFinite)
    .filter(Number.isFinite);
  if (rows.length < 2) return null;
  const mean = rows.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / rows.length;
  const variance = rows.reduce(
    (sum, value) => sum + (value - mean) ** 2,
    0
  ) / (rows.length - 1);
  return Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, variance));
}

function atlasMetalsMathDrawdown(points) {
  if (!Array.isArray(points) || points.length < 2) return null;
  let peak = points[0];
  let peakIndex = 0;
  let maxPct = 0;
  let start = points[0];
  let trough = points[0];
  points.forEach((point, index) => {
    if (point.y > peak.y) {
      peak = point;
      peakIndex = index;
    }
    const pct = peak.y > 0 ? ((peak.y - point.y) / peak.y) * 100 : 0;
    if (pct > maxPct) {
      maxPct = pct;
      start = points[peakIndex];
      trough = point;
    }
  });
  return { pct: maxPct, start, trough };
}

function atlasMetalsMathCoreMetrics() {
  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  const asset = atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal();
  const periodDays = Number(metals.period || 7);
  const periodLabel = atlasChartPeriodLabel(periodDays);
  const rows = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPeriodRows(periodDays);
  const points = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(asset.id, periodDays);
  const returns = [];
  for (let index = 1; index < points.length; index += 1) {
    const previous = Number(points[index - 1].y);
    const current = Number(points[index].y);
    if (previous > 0 && current > 0) returns.push(Math.log(current / previous));
  }
  const volatilitySessionPct = returns.length >= 2
    ? atlasMetalsMathSampleStd(returns) * 100
    : null;
  const drawdown = atlasMetalsMathDrawdown(points);
  const values = points.map(point => Number(point.y)).filter(Number.isFinite);
  const low = values.length ? Math.min(...values) : null;
  const high = values.length ? Math.max(...values) : null;
  const amplitudePct = Number.isFinite(low) && low > 0 && Number.isFinite(high)
    ? ((high - low) / low) * 100
    : null;
  const completenessPct = rows.length
    ? Math.min(100, (points.length / rows.length) * 100)
    : null;
  const reading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(asset.id, periodDays);
  const quote = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationQuote(asset.id);
  const first = points[0] || null;
  const last = points[points.length - 1] || null;
  const latestStepPct = points.length >= 2
    ? ((points[points.length - 1].y / points[points.length - 2].y) - 1) * 100
    : null;
  return {
    asset,
    periodDays,
    periodLabel,
    rows,
    points,
    returns,
    reading,
    quote,
    first,
    last,
    latestStepPct,
    volatilitySessionPct,
    drawdown,
    low,
    high,
    amplitudePct,
    completenessPct,
    ready: reading?.available === true && points.length >= 2
  };
}

function atlasMetalsMathFormatPct(value, digits = 2) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(Number(value))) return "Indisponible";
  const number = Number(value);
  const sign = number > 0 ? "+" : "";
  return `${sign}${new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
    minimumFractionDigits: digits,
    maximumFractionDigits: digits
  }).format(number)} %`;
}

function atlasMetalsMathDate(value) {
  const timestamp = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(timestamp)
    ? new Date(timestamp).toLocaleDateString("fr-FR")
    : "—";
}

function atlasMetalsMathRestoreCryptoLabels() {
  const shell = document.getElementById("math");
  if (!shell) return false;
  shell.dataset.mathDomain = "crypto";
  shell.classList.remove("atlas-math-metals");
  const eyebrow = shell.querySelector(".atlas-math-dock-head .eyebrow");
  const title = shell.querySelector(".atlas-math-dock-head h2");
  const muted = shell.querySelector(".muted-line");
  const detailsTitle = shell.querySelector(".atlas-score-components h3");
  if (eyebrow) eyebrow.textContent = "ATLAS MATH CORE V3";
  if (title) title.textContent = "Risque historique et qualité de série";
  if (muted) muted.textContent = "Lecture humaine d’abord · mesures factuelles et limites visibles.";
  if (detailsTitle) detailsTitle.textContent = "Composantes de l’indice";
  return true;
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationComparison(periodDays = null) {

    periodDays ?? atlasParallelMarketMetalsState().period ?? 7
  );

      asset,

        ? Number(reading.percent)
        : null
    });
  });
  const available = rows
    .filter(row => row.available && Number.isFinite(row.percent))
    .sort((left, right) => right.percent - left.percent);
  const leader = available[0] || null;
  const laggard = available[available.length - 1] || null;
  const spread = leader && laggard
    ? leader.percent - laggard.percent
    : null;
  return Object.freeze({
    days,
    rows: Object.freeze(rows),
    available: Object.freeze(available),
    count: available.length,
    complete: available.length === ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.length,
    leader,
    laggard,
    spread
  });
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderAnalysisHorizons(assetId = null) {
  const id = String(assetId || atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal()?.id || "gold");
  const historyAvailable = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationSummary().historyAvailable;

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metals-analysis-horizon]").forEach(card => {
    const days = Number(card.dataset.metalsAnalysisHorizon || 0);
    const output = card.querySelector("small");
    if (!output) return;

    const reading = historyAvailable
      ? atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(id, days)
      : Object.freeze({
          available: false,
          state: "insufficient",
          text: "Historique public en attente",
          detail: "Aucune valeur de remplacement"
        });

    output.textContent = reading.text;
    output.title = reading.detail || reading.text;
    card.dataset.horizonState = reading.state;
    card.classList.toggle("is-up", reading.state === "up");
    card.classList.toggle("is-down", reading.state === "down");
    card.classList.toggle("is-flat", reading.state === "stable");
    card.classList.toggle(
      "is-insufficient",
      ["insufficient", "intraday_required", "incoherent"].includes(reading.state)
    );
  });

  return true;
}

function atlasMetalsHumanReadingPeriodLabel(periodDays) {
  const days = Number(periodDays || 7);
  if (days === 1) return "24 heures";
  if (days === 365) return "1 an";
  return `${days} jours`;
}

function atlasMetalsHumanReadingMovement(percent) {
  const value = Number(percent);
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
    return Object.freeze({ state: "unknown", short: "lecture indisponible", sentence: "Variation non calculable" });
  }
  const magnitude = Math.abs(value);
  if (magnitude < 0.25) {
    return Object.freeze({ state: "stable", short: "quasi-stabilité", sentence: "Quasi-stabilité" });
  }
  const up = value > 0;
  if (magnitude < 1) {
    return Object.freeze({
      state: up ? "up" : "down",
      short: up ? "légère hausse" : "léger recul",
      sentence: up ? "Légère progression" : "Léger recul"
    });
  }
  if (magnitude < 3) {
    return Object.freeze({
      state: up ? "up" : "down",
      short: up ? "hausse modérée" : "baisse modérée",
      sentence: up ? "Progression modérée" : "Baisse modérée"
    });
  }
  if (magnitude < 8) {
    return Object.freeze({
      state: up ? "up" : "down",
      short: up ? "hausse marquée" : "baisse marquée",
      sentence: up ? "Progression marquée" : "Baisse marquée"
    });
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    state: up ? "up" : "down",
    short: up ? "forte hausse" : "fort recul",
    sentence: up ? "Forte progression" : "Fort recul"
  });
}

function atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(percent) {
  const value = Number(percent);
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "—";
  const sign = value > 0 ? "+" : "";
  return `${sign}${new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2
  }).format(value)} %`;
}

  const card = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsHumanReading");
  const title = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsHumanReadingTitle");
  const period = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsHumanReadingPeriod");

--- atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading #4 @2013438 ---
ent);
  const dateOptions = intraday
    ? { day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }
    : undefined;
  return Object.freeze({
    available: true,
    state: percent > 0 ? "up" : percent < 0 ? "down" : "stable",

    percent,
    delta,
    points: points.length,
    first,
    last,
    spanHours,
    source: intraday ? "yahoo_finance_futures_intraday" : "yahoo_finance_futures_daily"
  });
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationComparison(periodDays = null) {
  const days = Number(
    periodDays ?? atlasParallelMarketMetalsState().period ?? 7
  );
  const rows = ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.map(asset => {
    const reading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(asset.id, days);
    return Object.freeze({
      asset,
      reading,
      available: reading?.available === true,
      percent: reading?.available === true
        ? Number(reading.percent)
        : null
    });
  });
  const available = rows
    .filter(row => row.available && Number.isFinite(row.percent))
    .sort((left, right) => right.percent - left.percent);
  const leader = available[0] || null;
  const laggard = available[available.length - 1] || null;
  const spread = leader && laggard
    ? leader.percent - laggard.percent
    : null;
  return Object.freeze({
    days,
    rows: Object.freeze(rows),
    available: Object.freeze(available),
    count: available.length,
    complete: available.length === ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.length,
    leader,
    laggard,
    spread
  });
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderAnalysisHorizons(assetId = null) {
  const id = String(assetId || atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal()?.id || "gold");
  const historyAvailable = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationSummary().historyAvailable;

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metals-analysis-horizon]").forEach(card => {
    const days = Number(card.dataset.metalsAnalysisHorizon || 0);
    const output = card.querySelector("small");
    if (!output) return;

    const reading = historyAvailable
      ? atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(id, days)
      : Object.freeze({
          available: false,
          state: "insufficient",
          text: "Historique public en attente",
          detail: "Aucune valeur de remplacement"
        });

    output.textContent = reading.text;
    output.title = reading.detail || reading.text;
    card.dataset.horizonState = reading.state;
    card.classList.toggle("is-up", reading.state === "up");
    card.classList.toggle("is-down", reading.state === "down");
    card.classList.toggle("is-flat", reading.state === "stable");
    card.classList.toggle(
      "is-insufficient",
      ["insufficient", "intraday_required", "incoherent"].includes(reading.state)
    );
  });

  return true;
}

function atlasMetalsHumanReadingPeriodLabel(periodDays) {
  const days = Number(periodDays || 7);
  if (days === 1) return "24 heures";
  if (days === 365) return "1 an";
  return `${days} jours`;
}

function atlasMetalsHumanReadingMovement(percent) {
  const value = Number(percent);
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
    return Object.freeze({ state: "unknown", short: "lecture indisponible", sentence: "Variation non calculable" });
  }
  const magnitude = Math.abs(value);
  if (magnitude < 0.25) {
    return Object.freeze({ state: "stable", short: "quasi-stabilité", sentence: "Quasi-stabilité" });
  }
  const up = value > 0;
  if (magnitude < 1) {
    return Object.freeze({
      state: up ? "up" : "down",
      short: up ? "légère hausse" : "léger recul",
      sentence: up ? "Légère progression" : "Léger recul"
    });
  }
  if (magnitude < 3) {
    return Object.freeze({
      state: up ? "up" : "down",
      short: up ? "hausse modérée" : "baisse modérée",
      sentence: up ? "Progression modérée" : "Baisse modérée"
    });
  }
  if (magnitude < 8) {
    return Object.freeze({
      state: up ? "up" : "down",
      short: up ? "hausse marquée" : "baisse marquée",
      sentence: up ? "Progression marquée" : "Baisse marquée"
    });
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    state: up ? "up" : "down",
    short: up ? "forte hausse" : "fort recul",
    sentence: up ? "Forte progression" : "Fort recul"
  });
}

function atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(percent) {
  const value = Number(percent);
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "—";
  const sign = value > 0 ? "+" : "";
  return `${sign}${new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2
  }).format(value)} %`;
}

      ? "Comparaison Base 100 · Yahoo Finance Futures intraday · cinq séries séparées · aucune moyenne artificielle."
      : "Comparaison Base 100 · Yahoo Finance Futures · cinq séries séparées · aucune moyenne artificielle.";

    if (!comparison.complete) {
      card.dataset.state = "insufficient";
      state.textContent = `${comparison.count}/5 séries`;
      summary.textContent = "La comparaison globale attend les cinq historiques réels.";
      context.textContent = comparison.rows.map(row => (
        `${row.asset.symbol} : ${row.available ? atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(row.percent) : "non mesuré"}`
      )).join(" · ");
      setText(document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDetailDecision"), "Comparaison historique");
      return false;
    }

    const leaderMove = atlasMetalsHumanReadingMovement(
      comparison.leader?.percent
    );
    card.dataset.state = leaderMove.state;
    state.textContent = "Comparaison 5/5";
    summary.textContent =
      `Leader ${comparison.leader.asset.symbol} ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(comparison.leader.percent)}`
      + ` · retard ${comparison.laggard.asset.symbol} ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(comparison.laggard.percent)}`
      + ` · écart ${new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
          minimumFractionDigits: 2,
          maximumFractionDigits: 2
        }).format(comparison.spread)} points.`;
    context.textContent = comparison.rows.map(row => (
      `${row.asset.symbol} ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(row.percent)}`
    )).join(" · ");
    setText(document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDetailDecision"), "Comparaison historique");
    return true;
  }

  const activeReading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(asset.id, days);

  title.textContent = `${asset.name} · lecture sur ${periodLabel}`;
  period.textContent = `${asset.symbol} · ${periodLabel}`;
  source.textContent = spot
    ? "Historique Yahoo Finance Futures intraday · cotation Gold API distincte · observation uniquement, aucune prévision."
    : "Historique Yahoo Finance Futures · cotation Gold API distincte · observation uniquement, aucune prévision.";

  if (!activeReading) {
    card.dataset.state = "loading";
    state.textContent = "En attente";
    summary.textContent = "Historique public en cours de lecture.";
    context.textContent = "Aucune conclusion de remplacement n’est générée.";
    return false;
  }

  if (!activeReading.available) {
    card.dataset.state = activeReading.state || "insufficient";
    state.textContent = spot ? "En constitution" : "Insuffisant";
    summary.textContent = spot
      ? `La série Futures intraday 24 heures n’est pas encore disponible : ${activeReading.detail}.`
      : "Le nombre de séances disponibles ne permet pas une lecture historique fiable sur cette période.";
  } else {
    const movement = atlasMetalsHumanReadingMovement(activeReading.percent);
    card.dataset.state = movement.state;
    state.textContent = "Observation";
    summary.textContent = spot
      ? `${movement.sentence} sur 24 heures : ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(activeReading.percent)} sur ${activeReading.points} points Futures intraday.`
      : `${movement.sentence} sur ${periodLabel} : ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(activeReading.percent)} sur ${activeReading.points} séances Futures.`;
  }

  const horizonLabels = new Map([[7, "7 j"], [30, "30 j"], [90, "90 j"], [365, "1 an"]]);
  const horizonText = [7, 30, 90, 365].map(horizon => {
    const reading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(asset.id, horizon);
    if (!reading.available) return `${horizonLabels.get(horizon)} : non mesuré`;
    return `${horizonLabels.get(horizon)} : ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingMovement(reading.percent).short}`;
  });
  context.textContent = horizonText.join(" · ");

  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDetailDecision"),
    "Observation historique"
  );
  return Boolean(activeReading.available);
}

    return false;

    value.textContent = days === 1 ? "EN CONSTITUTION" : "HISTORIQUE INSUFFISANT";
    detail.textContent = reading.detail || reading.text;
    return false;
  }

  const sign = reading.percent > 0 ? "+" : "";
  value.textContent = `${sign}${new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2
  }).format(reading.percent)} %`;
  const current = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationQuote(asset?.id);
  const currentText = current?.price !== null && current?.price !== undefined
    ? ` · cotation actuelle ${atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPriceText(current)} séparée`

const atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState = {
  canvas: null,
  geometry: null,
  baseImage: null,
  pointer: null,
  frame: 0,
  installed: false
};

function atlasMetalsCursorInspectorPanel() {
  return document.getElementById("atlasMetalsChartMarketPanel");
}

function atlasMetalsCursorInspectorRestoreBase() {
  const canvas = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.canvas;
  const image = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.baseImage;
  const geometry = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.geometry;
  if (!canvas || !image || !geometry) return false;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  if (!ctx) return false;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
  ctx.putImageData(image, 0, 0);
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.setTransform(geometry.dpr, 0, 0, geometry.dpr, 0, 0);
  return true;
}

function atlasMetalsCursorInspectorHide(options = {}) {
  const panel = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorPanel();
  atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.pointer = null;
  if (options.restore !== false) atlasMetalsCursorInspectorRestoreBase();
  if (!panel) return;
  panel.hidden = true;
  panel.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  panel.removeAttribute("data-dock");
  panel.style.removeProperty("left");
  panel.style.removeProperty("top");
}

function atlasMetalsCursorInspectorReset(canvas = null) {
  if (atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.frame) {
    cancelAnimationFrame(atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.frame);
    atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.frame = 0;
  }
  atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.canvas = canvas || atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.canvas;
  atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.geometry = null;
  atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.baseImage = null;
  atlasMetalsCursorInspectorHide({ restore: false });
}

function atlasMetalsCursorNearestPoint(points, targetX) {
  const rows = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationArray(points);
  if (!rows.length || !Number.isFinite(Number(targetX))) return null;
  let low = 0;
  let high = rows.length - 1;
  while (low < high) {
    const middle = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
    if (Number(rows[middle]?.x) < targetX) low = middle + 1;
    else high = middle;
  }
  const right = rows[low] || null;
  const left = rows[Math.max(0, low - 1)] || null;
  if (!left) return right;
  if (!right) return left;
  return Math.abs(Number(left.x) - targetX) <= Math.abs(Number(right.x) - targetX)
    ? left
    : right;
}

function atlasMetalsCursorMedianInterval(points) {
  const rows = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationArray(points)
    .map(point => Number(point?.x))
    .filter(Number.isFinite)
    .sort((left, right) => left - right);
  if (rows.length < 2) return Infinity;
  const intervals = [];
  for (let index = 1; index < rows.length; index += 1) {
    const delta = rows[index] - rows[index - 1];
    if (delta > 0) intervals.push(delta);
  }
  if (!intervals.length) return Infinity;
  intervals.sort((left, right) => left - right);
  return intervals[Math.floor(intervals.length / 2)];
}

function atlasParallelMarketRenderMetals() {
  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  const selected = new Set(metals.selectionIds);
  const allSeriesActive = atlasParallelMarketMetalsAllActive();

  const activeMetal = atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal();

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metal-id]").forEach(button => {
    const active = selected.has(button.dataset.metalId);
    const focused = button.dataset.metalId === activeMetal.id;
    button.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
    button.classList.toggle("is-focus", focused);
    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", active ? "true" : "false");
    button.setAttribute("aria-current", focused ? "true" : "false");
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metal-row]").forEach(row => {
    row.hidden = !selected.has(row.dataset.metalRow);
    row.classList.toggle(
      "is-focus",
      row.dataset.metalRow === activeMetal.id
    );
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metal-legend]").forEach(item => {
    const id = String(item.dataset.metalLegend || "");
    const active = selected.has(id);
    const focused = id === activeMetal.id;
    const asset = ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.find(record => record.id === id);
    const reading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(id, metals.period);
    item.hidden = !active;
    item.classList.toggle("is-focus", focused && !allSeriesActive);
    item.classList.toggle("is-comparison", allSeriesActive);
    item.style.setProperty(
      "--atlas-metal-series-color",
      ATLAS_METALS_CHART_COLORS[id] || "#9fb3c2"
    );
    item.textContent = allSeriesActive && reading?.available
      ? `${asset?.symbol || id.toUpperCase()} ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(reading.percent)}`
      : asset?.symbol || id.toUpperCase();
    item.title = reading?.available
      ? `${asset?.name || id} · ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(reading.percent)} · cliquer pour revenir au prix réel`
      : `${asset?.name || id} · cliquer pour afficher le prix réel`;
  });

  const allSeriesButton = document.querySelector("[data-metals-all-series]");
  if (allSeriesButton) {
    allSeriesButton.classList.toggle("is-active", allSeriesActive);
    allSeriesButton.setAttribute(
      "aria-pressed",
      allSeriesActive ? "true" : "false"
    );
    allSeriesButton.textContent = allSeriesActive ? "TOUS 5/5" : "TOUS";
  }

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metals-period]").forEach(button => {
    const value = Number(button.dataset.metalsPeriod);
    const active = value === Number(metals.period);
    button.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
    const spotReading = value === 1
      ? atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal().id, 1)
      : null;
    button.classList.remove("is-unavailable");
    button.classList.toggle("is-building", value === 1 && spotReading?.available !== true);
    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", active ? "true" : "false");
    if (value === 1) {
      button.title = spotReading?.available
        ? "Historique 24 h réel · Yahoo Finance Futures intraday"
        : `Intraday Futures en attente · ${spotReading?.detail || "première collecte GitHub Actions requise"}`;
      button.setAttribute(
        "aria-label",
        spotReading?.available
          ? "24 heures mesurées par Yahoo Finance Futures intraday"
          : "Historique Futures intraday 24 heures en attente"
      );
    }
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metals-view]").forEach(button => {
    const active = button.dataset.metalsView === metals.view;
    button.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", active ? "true" : "false");
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metals-section]").forEach(button => {
    const active = button.dataset.metalsSection === metals.section;
    button.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", active ? "true" : "false");
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metals-view-panel]").forEach(panel => {
    panel.hidden = panel.dataset.metalsViewPanel !== metals.section;
  });

  const assets = atlasParallelMarketSelectedMetals();
  const symbols = assets.map(asset => asset.symbol).join(" / ");
  const summary = document.getElementById(
    "atlasMetalsSelectionSummary"
  );
  if (summary) {
    summary.textContent = assets.length
      ? `${assets.length} métal${assets.length > 1 ? "x" : ""} `
        + `sélectionné${assets.length > 1 ? "s" : ""} · ${symbols}`
      : "Aucun métal sélectionné";
  }

  const truth = document.getElementById(
    "atlasMetalsFoundationTruth"
  );
  if (truth) {
    const quoteSummary = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationSummary();
    truth.textContent = metals.section === "critical"
      ? "USGS préparé · import structurel non connecté"
      : `${metals.view === "base100" ? "Base 100" : "Prix"} · `
        + `${atlasChartPeriodLabel(metals.period)} · `
        + quoteSummary.truth;
  }

  atlasParallelMarketRenderMetalsDetail();
  atlasParallelMarketRenderMetalsMarket();
  atlasMarketRegistryRenderCatalog();
  if (atlasParallelMarketDomain() === "metals") renderAtlasMathCore();
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationComparison(periodDays = null) {
  const days = Number(
    periodDays ?? atlasParallelMarketMetalsState().period ?? 7
  );
  const rows = ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.map(asset => {
    const reading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(asset.id, days);
    return Object.freeze({
      asset,
      reading,
      available: reading?.available === true,
      percent: reading?.available === true
        ? Number(reading.percent)
        : null
    });
  });
  const available = rows
    .filter(row => row.available && Number.isFinite(row.percent))
    .sort((left, right) => right.percent - left.percent);
  const leader = available[0] || null;
  const laggard = available[available.length - 1] || null;
  const spread = leader && laggard
    ? leader.percent - laggard.percent
    : null;
  return Object.freeze({
    days,
    rows: Object.freeze(rows),
    available: Object.freeze(available),
    count: available.length,
    complete: available.length === ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.length,
    leader,
    laggard,
    spread
  });
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderAnalysisHorizons(assetId = null) {
  const id = String(assetId || atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal()?.id || "gold");
  const historyAvailable = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationSummary().historyAvailable;

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metals-analysis-horizon]").forEach(card => {
    const days = Number(card.dataset.metalsAnalysisHorizon || 0);
    const output = card.querySelector("small");
    if (!output) return;

    const reading = historyAvailable
      ? atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(id, days)
      : Object.freeze({
          available: false,
          state: "insufficient",
          text: "Historique public en attente",
          detail: "Aucune valeur de remplacement"
        });

    output.textContent = reading.text;
    output.title = reading.detail || reading.text;
    card.dataset.horizonState = reading.state;
    card.classList.toggle("is-up", reading.state === "up");
    card.classList.toggle("is-down", reading.state === "down");
    card.classList.toggle("is-flat", reading.state === "stable");
    card.classList.toggle(
      "is-insufficient",
      ["insufficient", "intraday_required", "incoherent"].includes(reading.state)
    );
  });

  return true;
}

function atlasMetalsHumanReadingPeriodLabel(periodDays) {
  const days = Number(periodDays || 7);
  if (days === 1) return "24 heures";
  if (days === 365) return "1 an";
  return `${days} jours`;
}

function atlasMetalsHumanReadingMovement(percent) {
  const value = Number(percent);
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
    return Object.freeze({ state: "unknown", short: "lecture indisponible", sentence: "Variation non calculable" });
  }
  const magnitude = Math.abs(value);
  if (magnitude < 0.25) {
    return Object.freeze({ state: "stable", short: "quasi-stabilité", sentence: "Quasi-stabilité" });
  }
  const up = value > 0;
  if (magnitude < 1) {
    return Object.freeze({
      state: up ? "up" : "down",
      short: up ? "légère hausse" : "léger recul",
      sentence: up ? "Légère progression" : "Léger recul"
    });
  }
  if (magnitude < 3) {
    return Object.freeze({
      state: up ? "up" : "down",
      short: up ? "hausse modérée" : "baisse modérée",
      sentence: up ? "Progression modérée" : "Baisse modérée"
    });
  }
  if (magnitude < 8) {
    return Object.freeze({
      state: up ? "up" : "down",
      short: up ? "hausse marquée" : "baisse marquée",
      sentence: up ? "Progression marquée" : "Baisse marquée"
    });
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    state: up ? "up" : "down",
    short: up ? "forte hausse" : "fort recul",
    sentence: up ? "Forte progression" : "Fort recul"
  });
}

function atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(percent) {
  const value = Number(percent);
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "—";
  const sign = value > 0 ? "+" : "";
  return `${sign}${new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2
  }).format(value)} %`;
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderMarketRows() {

    .querySelectorAll("[data-metals-market-row]")
    .forEach(row => {

        row.dataset.metalsMarketRow

      cells[5].textContent = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationChangeText(quote);

    .forEach(card => {

        card.dataset.metalsMarketCard
      );
      const value = card.querySelector("em");
      if (value) {
        value.textContent = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPriceText(quote);
      }
    });

async function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationLoadCore() {
  atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.status = "loading";
  atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.error = null;

  let archiveError = null;
  try {
    const archive = await atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationLoadFromArchive();
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.snapshot = archive.snapshot;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.collector = archive.collector;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.historyIndex = archive.historyIndex;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.history = archive.history.snapshots;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.intradayHistory = archive.intradayHistory;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.spotHistory = archive.spotHistory.snapshots;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.contract = archive.contract;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.quotes = archive.snapshot.quotes;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.status = archive.snapshot.quotes.length
      ? "loaded"
      : "ready_empty";
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.origin = "github_archive";
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.loadedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.error = null;
  } catch (error) {
    archiveError = String(error?.message || error || "Archive publique Métaux indisponible");
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.status = "unavailable";
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.origin = "none";
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.snapshot = null;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.collector = null;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.historyIndex = null;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.history = Object.freeze([]);
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.intradayHistory = null;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.spotHistory = Object.freeze([]);
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.contract = null;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.quotes = Object.freeze([]);
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.loadedAt = null;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.error = archiveError;
  }

  atlasParallelMarketRenderMetals();
  return atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.status;
}

  } catch (error) {

    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.quotes = Object.freeze([]);
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.loadedAt = null;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.error = archiveError;
  }

  atlasParallelMarketRenderMetals();
  return atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.status;
}

async function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationReloadHistoryCore() {
  try {
    let history = null;
    let intradayHistory = null;
    let spotHistory = null;
    if (["github_archive", "book_memory", "interface_memory"].includes(
      atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.origin
    )) {
      [history, intradayHistory, spotHistory] = await Promise.all([
        atlasMarketRegistryFetchJson(ATLAS_METALS_QUOTE_FOUNDATION_PATHS.historyResponse)
          .then(atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationValidateHistoryResponse),
        atlasMarketRegistryFetchJson(ATLAS_METALS_QUOTE_FOUNDATION_PATHS.intradayHistory)
          .then(atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationValidateIntradayHistory)
          .catch(() => null),
        atlasMarketRegistryFetchJson(ATLAS_METALS_QUOTE_FOUNDATION_PATHS.spotHistory)
          .then(atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationValidateSpotHistory)
          .catch(() => null)
      ]);
    } else if (atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.origin === "local_bridge") {
      const period = Number(atlasParallelMarketMetalsState().period || 1);
      const route = await atlasMetalsBridgeFetchJson(
        `${ATLAS_METALS_BRIDGE_PATHS.history}?days=${period}`
      );
      history = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationValidateHistoryResponse(route?.history);
    }
    if (!history && !intradayHistory && !spotHistory) {
      atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderChart();
      return false;
    }
    if (history) atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.history = history.snapshots;
    if (intradayHistory) atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.intradayHistory = intradayHistory;
    if (spotHistory) atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.spotHistory = spotHistory.snapshots;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.error = null;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderAnalysisHorizons();
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderChart();
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.error = String(error?.message || error);
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderAnalysisHorizons();
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderChart();
    return false;
  }
}

function atlasParallelMarketRenderMetalsMarket() {
  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  const selected = new Set(metals.selectionIds);
  const active = atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal();
  const filter = [
    "all",
    "monetary",
    "precious-industrial",
    "industrial"
  ].includes(String(metals.marketFilter || ""))
    ? String(metals.marketFilter)
    : "all";

  document
    .querySelectorAll("[data-metals-market-card]")
    .forEach(button => {
      const id = button.dataset.metalsMarketCard;
      button.hidden = !selected.has(id);
      button.classList.toggle("is-focus", id === active.id);
      button.setAttribute(
        "aria-current",
        id === active.id ? "true" : "false"
      );
    });

  document
    .querySelectorAll("[data-metals-market-row]")
    .forEach(row => {
      const id = row.dataset.metalsMarketRow;
      const family = row.dataset.metalsMarketFamily;
      const matches =
        selected.has(id)
        && (filter === "all" || family === filter);

      row.hidden = !matches;
      row.classList.toggle("is-focus", id === active.id);
    });

  document
    .querySelectorAll("[data-metals-market-filter]")
    .forEach(button => {
      const isActive =
        button.dataset.metalsMarketFilter === filter;
      button.classList.toggle("is-active", isActive);
      button.setAttribute(
        "aria-pressed",
        isActive ? "true" : "false"
      );
    });

  const symbols = atlasParallelMarketSelectedMetals()
    .map(asset => asset.symbol)
    .join(" · ");

  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsTargetSymbols"),
    symbols || "Aucune sélection"
  );

  const visibleRows = [
    ...document.querySelectorAll(
      "[data-metals-market-row]:not([hidden])"
    )
  ].length;

  atlasMetalsStructuralRenderMarketRows();
  atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderMarketRows();

  const quoteSummary = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationSummary();
  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsMarketStatus"),
    `${visibleRows} actif${visibleRows > 1 ? "s" : ""} visible`
    + `${visibleRows > 1 ? "s" : ""} · ${quoteSummary.market}`
  );

  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsHeaderDecision"),
    `PANIER MÉTAUX ${selected.size}/5 · STRUCTURE ${selected.size}/5`
    + ` · COTATIONS ${quoteSummary.quoteCount}/5`
  );
  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsLiveStatus"),
    `Marché Métaux · ${quoteSummary.short}`
  );
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationSummary() {
  const summary = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationSummaryCore();
  if (!["book_memory", "interface_memory"].includes(atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.origin) || summary.quoteCount < 1) return summary;
  return {
    quoteCount: summary.quoteCount,
    short: `Archive publique ${summary.quoteCount}/5`,
    domain: `${summary.quoteCount}/5 cotations restaurées depuis le rapport public Métaux`,
    market: `${summary.quoteCount}/5 cotations conservées · historique public annuel`,
    truth: `${summary.quoteCount}/5 cotations réelles restaurées depuis GitHub / IndexedDB`
  };
}

async function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationLoad() {
  // Restore the local report first, then let the public archive win when it is reachable.
  // This prevents an IndexedDB hydration finishing after the network load from downgrading
  // the Metals state to book_memory and stranding the 24 h intraday Futures series.
  await atlasMetalsReportState.restorePromise;
  const fallbackPackage = atlasMetalsReportState.package;
  const status = await atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationLoadCore();

  // The 24 h Futures archive is an independent public asset. A transient failure
  // on the first fetch must not leave a 5/5 Metals workspace stranded at 0/5.
  if (atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.origin === "github_archive"
      && atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationArray(atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.intradayHistory?.series).length !== ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.length) {
    try {
      atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.intradayHistory =
        atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationValidateIntradayHistory(
          await atlasMarketRegistryFetchJson(ATLAS_METALS_QUOTE_FOUNDATION_PATHS.intradayHistory)
        );
      atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.error = null;
      atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderAnalysisHorizons();
      atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderChart();
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn("Nouvelle tentative intraday Futures Métaux non disponible :", error);
    }
  }

  if (["local_bridge", "github_archive"].includes(atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.origin)
      && atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationSummary().quoteCount === 5) {
    await atlasMetalsReportProduceFromCurrent();
  } else if (fallbackPackage
      && atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationSummary().quoteCount === 0) {
    atlasMetalsReportHydrateQuoteState(fallbackPackage, "book_memory");
  }
  return status;
}

async function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationReloadHistory() {
  const ok = await atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationReloadHistoryCore();
  if (ok) await atlasMetalsReportProduceFromCurrent();
  return ok;
}

const MARKET_CACHE_KEY = "agent_crypto_erith_ia_market_cache_top250_v4";

const LEGACY_MARKET_CACHE_KEYS = ["agent_crypto_erith_ia_market_cache_top50_v2", "agent_crypto_erith_ia_market_cache_v1_1_alpha_26_37_top50", "agent_crypto_erith_ia_market_cache_v1_1_alpha_26_36_atomic_250", "agent_crypto_erith_ia_market_cache_cmc_top50_v2"];

function saveMarketCache() {
  if (!state.coins?.length || !["direct", "github-public"].includes(state.sourceLock?.mode) || !atlasCanonicalSnapshot(state.coins)) return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(MARKET_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
      schema: "atlas_market_cache_top250_v1",
      version: ATLAS_RELEASE,
      saved_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      canonical_source: ATLAS_CANONICAL_MARKET_SOURCE,
      source_mode: state.sourceLock.mode,
      snapshot_id: state.sourceLock.snapshotId,
      source: state.mainSource || ATLAS_CANONICAL_MARKET_SOURCE,
      timestamp: state.timestamp || new Date().toISOString(),
      coins: state.coins,
      global: state.global
    }));
  } catch {}
}

function loadMarketCache() {
  const keys = [MARKET_CACHE_KEY, ...LEGACY_MARKET_CACHE_KEYS];
  for (const key of keys) {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
      const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
      if (!parsed || parsed.canonical_source !== ATLAS_CANONICAL_MARKET_SOURCE || !atlasCanonicalSnapshot(parsed.coins)) continue;
      if (key !== MARKET_CACHE_KEY) {
        try { localStorage.setItem(MARKET_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ ...parsed, version: ATLAS_RELEASE, migrated_from: key })); } catch {}
      }
      return parsed;
    } catch {}
  }
  return null;
}

function atlasPrimeMarketCacheSilently() {
  const cache = loadMarketCache();
  atlasStartup.cacheAvailable = !!cache;
  atlasStartup.cacheTimestamp = cache?.timestamp || null;
  return !!cache;
}

function applyMarketCache(reason = "CoinGecko direct indisponible : dernière lecture directe conservée en archive locale.") {
  const cache = loadMarketCache();
  if (!cache) return false;
  const applied = atlasApplyCanonicalSnapshot({ coins: cache.coins, global: cache.global, timestamp: cache.timestamp, snapshotId: cache.snapshot_id, sourceLabel: cache.source ? `${cache.source} · archive locale` : "CoinGecko · archive locale" }, "local-cache");
  if (!applied) return false;
  setLiveStatus("warn", "Mode archive");
  setText(els.sourceName, state.mainSource);
  setText(els.sourceTime, atlasExactTimestampLabel(state.timestamp));
  setTableDecision(`DONNÉES HISTORIQUES ANCIENNES · snapshot ${atlasExactTimestampLabel(state.timestamp)} · analyses suspendues`, "warn");
  atlasRenderMarketAccessNotice();
  renderAll();
  return true;
}

      failure.code = `${AGENT_CRYPTO_RESET_ERROR_PREFIX}-LOCA

    panel.hidden = panel.dataset.metalsViewPanel !== metals.section;
  });

  const assets = atlasParallelMarketSelectedMetals();
  const symbols = assets.map(asset => asset.symbol).join(" / ");
  const summary = document.getElementById(
    "atlasMetalsSelectionSummary"
  );
  if (summary) {
    summary.textContent = assets.length
      ? `${assets.length} métal${assets.length > 1 ? "x" : ""} `
        + `sélectionné${assets.length > 1 ? "s" : ""} · ${symbols}`
      : "Aucun métal sélectionné";
  }

  const truth = document.getElementById(
    "atlasMetalsFoundationTruth"
  );
  if (truth) {
    const quoteSummary = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationSummary();
    truth.textContent = metals.section === "critical"
      ? "USGS préparé · import structurel non connecté"
      : `${metals.view === "base100" ? "Base 100" : "Prix"} · `
        + `${atlasChartPeriodLabel(metals.period)} · `
        + quoteSummary.truth;
  }

  atlasParallelMarketRenderMetalsDetail();
  atlasParallelMarketRenderMetalsMarket();
  atlasMarketRegistryRenderCatalog();
  if (atlasParallelMarketDomain() === "metals") renderAtlasMathCore();
}

    atlasParallelMarketHoldTimer = 0;
  };

  longPress?.addEventListener("pointerup", cancelHold);
  longPress?.addEventListener("pointercancel", cancelHold);
  longPress?.addEventListener("pointerleave", cancelHold);

  longPress?.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
    if (event.shiftKey && ["Enter", " "].includes(event.key)) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketToggle("title-keyboard");
    }
  });

  metalsMarketArea?.addEventListener("click", event => {

    if (card) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketSetActiveMetal(
        card.dataset.metalsMarketCard
      );
      return;
    }

    const row = event.target.closest("[data-metals-market-row]");
    if (row) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketSetActiveMetal(
        row.dataset.metalsMarketRow
      );

      "[data-metals-market-filter]"

      atlasParallelMarketSetMetalsMarketFilter(
        filter.dataset.metalsMarketFilter
      );
    }
  });

  metalsToolbar?.addEventListener("click", event => {
    const period = event.target.closest("[data-metals-period]");
    if (period) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketSetMetalsPeriod(
        period.dataset.metalsPeriod
      );
      return;
    }

    const view = event.target.closest("[data-metals-view]");
    if (view) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketSetMetalsView(
        view.dataset.metalsView
      );
      return;
    }

    const section = event.target.closest("[data-metals-section]");
    if (section) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketSetMetalsSection(
        section.dataset.metalsSection
      );
    }
  });

  foundation?.addEventListener("click", event => {
    const allSeries = event.target.closest("[data-metals-all-series]");
    if (allSeries) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketShowAllMetals();
      return;
    }

    const legendItem = event.target.closest("[data-metal-legend]");
    if (legendItem) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketSetActiveMetal(
        legendItem.dataset.metalLegend
      );
      return;
    }

    const metal = event.target.closest("[data-metal-id]");
    if (metal) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketToggleMetal(metal.dataset.metalId);
      return;
    }

    const row = event.target.closest("[data-metal-row]");
    if (row) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketSetActiveMetal(row.dataset.metalRow);
      return;
    }

    const period = event.target.closest("[data-metals-period]");
    if (period) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketSetMetalsPeriod(
        period.dataset.metalsPeriod
      );
      return;

    const view = event.target.closest("[data-metals-view]");

      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketSetMetalsView(
        view.dataset.metalsView
      );
      return;
